name: typesafe-ai-implementation
description: Independent ChatGPT and Codex guide for building bounded TypeSafe AI integrations in software.

interface.longDescription: An independent coding-agent guide for assessing an application, identifying a bounded semantic decision, and planning a focused TypeSafe AI integration. It includes offline Python and TypeScript scaffolds and keeps application policy, validation, and side effects in application code. This is not an official TypeSafe AI product and does not call the TypeSafe API. Jev is TypeSafe AI's System One model; for current API behavior, consult TypeSafe's official agent skill, documentation, and SDK.
capabilities: Assess codebases for bounded TypeSafe AI integration opportunities
Generate minimal Python and TypeScript integration scaffolds
defaultPrompt: Review this codebase for one bounded TypeSafe AI integration opportunity and propose a minimal implementation plan.
Inspect this code for a semantic decision that could use TypeSafe AI; distinguish it from deterministic rules.
Use the TypeSafe AI skill to scaffold a minimal Python or TypeScript integration after checking current docs.
